# path-one-host-outline

Purpose: Outline Path 1 hosting options — Anthropic Blender Connector vs manual MCP client — both need Blender Lab MCP add-on in Blender 5.1+.

Outline **Path 1 host surfaces** — **(a)** Anthropic Connector in Claude Desktop vs **(b)** any manually configured MCP client — while making clear that both require the Lab MCP add-on inside **Blender 5.1+** and that the Connector is **never standalone**. This skill provides an outline only; it never configures hosts and never runs Blender.

Metadata: Contract `v1.0.0` | Category `runtime-and-execution` | Role `lab-mcp-host-configuration-planner` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- user on Claude Desktop asking what the Anthropic Connector does vs the Blender-side add-on
- user or agent comparing Path 1 host surfaces: **(a)** Anthropic Connector in Claude Desktop vs **(b)** a manually configured MCP client
- outlining which components live on the host side vs inside Blender 5.1+ before setup begins
- Trigger phrases: "Connector vs Cursor MCP", "how do I host Lab MCP", "Claude Desktop Connector vs manual MCP client", "what hosts work with Path 1"

## Input & output contract
- Required input `path_one_host_option` (`string`): Selected Path 1 host mode: option (a) Anthropic Connector in Claude Desktop or option (b) manual MCP client
- Required input `blender_5_1_addon_posture` (`object`): Confirmation that Official Blender Lab MCP add-on in Blender 5.1+ is required by both host options
- Optional input `mcp_client_name` (`string`): Specific MCP client for host option (b) such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Zed
- Output contract: `path_one_host_architecture_outline`, `connector_not_standalone_boundary_check`, `host_to_readiness_handoff` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Outline only; never configures hosts and never runs Blender. Path 1 requires the Lab MCP add-on inside **Blender 5.1+** plus a host surface: **(a)** Anthropic Connector in Claude Desktop or **(b)** any manually configured MCP client. The Connector is **never standalone**. Path 2 (`mcp-for-blender`, formerly `ahujasid/blender-mcp`; see `docs/unofficial-runtime-bridges.md`) and CLI workflows (`cli-appendix-job-outline`) are out of scope here.
- Choosing between Path 1, Path 2, and the CLI appendix (owned by `runtime-path-picker`).
- Performing step-by-step installation or editing host MCP configuration files (owned by `official-runtime-setup-guide`).
- Probing whether a live Blender MCP session is currently connected (owned by `official-runtime-readiness-checker`).
- Documenting Path 2 community bridge internals or headless CLI batch scripts.
